Predicates:
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Likes($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x like y?
Chases($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x chase y?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?

Facts:
Big(BaldEagle, True) ::: The bald eagle is big.
Green(BaldEagle, False) ::: The bald eagle is not green.
Likes(BaldEagle, Bear, True) ::: The bald eagle likes the bear.
Likes(BaldEagle, Squirrel, True) ::: The bald eagle likes the squirrel.
Chases(Bear, Lion, True) ::: The bear chases the lion.
Green(Bear, True) ::: The bear is green.
Visits(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: The bear visits the bald eagle.
Visits(Bear, Squirrel, True) ::: The bear visits the squirrel.
Green(Lion, False) ::: The lion is not green.
Likes(Lion, Bear, True) ::: The lion likes the bear.
Visits(Lion, Squirrel, True) ::: The lion visits the squirrel.
Chases(Squirrel, BaldEagle, True) ::: The squirrel chases the bald eagle.
Cold(Squirrel, True) ::: The squirrel is cold.
Visits(Squirrel, BaldEagle, True) ::: The squirrel visits the bald eagle.

Rules:
Cold($x, True) >>> Young($x, False) ::: If someone is cold then they are not young.
Big($x, True) >>> Green($x, False) ::: All big people are not green.
Big(Lion, True) && Green(Lion, True) >>> Chases(Lion, BaldEagle, True) ::: If the lion is big and the lion is green then the lion chases the bald eagle.
Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Likes($x, Bear, True) ::: If someone chases the bald eagle then they like the bear.
Round($x, True) && Visits($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Likes(BaldEagle, Squirrel, True) ::: If someone is round and they visit the bald eagle then the bald eagle likes the squirrel.
Visits($x, Lion, True) >>> Likes($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If someone visits the lion then they like the bald eagle.
Visits(Lion, Squirrel, True) && Chases(Squirrel, Bear, True) >>> Chases(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: If the lion visits the squirrel and the squirrel chases the bear then the bear chases the bald eagle.
Visits($x, Lion, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If someone visits the lion then they are cold.
Likes($x, Bear, True) >>> Chases($x, Bear, True) ::: If someone likes the bear then they chase the bear.

Query:
Chases(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: The bear chases the bald eagle.
